04

Our approach to this case

We read your reputation continuously, in every language of your markets, and compare it with your competitors'. An analyst qualifies the changes every month, and alerts you as soon as a subject breaks the trend. You get an analysis note, not one more dashboard.

  1. 1Framing

    We set the perimeter: brands, products, markets, languages, competitors.

  2. 2Collection

    Monitoring runs continuously, 24/7, in more than twenty languages.

  3. 3Analysis

    An analyst reads the changes and qualifies what matters.

  4. 4Decision

    You receive a regular read and an alert as soon as a subject breaks the trend.

What we read

  • Social networksEverything that mentions your brand, products, leaders.
  • Reviews and forumsCustomer reviews and in-depth discussions.
